historical_reviews.deepseek: Literal range does not prove OCP1 and OCP2 separately and omits IB, complete Sensor List and Web evidence; capped SDR and password argument are incomplete/unsafe.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly requires mapping and complete evidence. This review adds installed OCP card identity, sensor-source semantics and passive link/load context.
historical_reviews.duplicate_search: No duplicate code; midplane or generic motherboard readings cannot substitute for OCP adapter temperature.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-35 requires both members, ED-36 requires hardware topology and semantics, and ED-38 protects links/logs and verdict ownership.

original_test_intent: Validate TEMP_OCP1 and TEMP_OCP2 as the temperature channels for the two applicable OCP adapter positions, with correct installed-card identity and consistent names, descriptions, readings and states across complete IB/OOB SDR, Sensor List and BMC Web.
original_method: The network/platform owner maps OCP1/OCP2 to physical slots and installed card serials, identifies on-card versus board-proxy sensing and approved thermal limits, then automation performs passive complete cross-path collection.
manual_activity: The network/platform owner binds OCP1/OCP2 to installed cards and defines sensor source, limits and Web entries. No card service, link flap, traffic generation or log clear is authorized.
required_inputs: OCP1/OCP2 physical slot, connector, BDF/interface and applicability mapping
Sensor source as adapter controller/on-die, module, external probe or board proxy
Exact SDR entity/name/description and Sensor List/Web mappings
Units, scale, tolerance, sampling/freshness and unavailable semantics
Approved ranges/states under documented link/traffic/cooling/ambient conditions
Same-target IB/OOB identity and BMC/SDR/NIC/spec revisions
Secret-safe complete collection and independent link/BMC/thermal recovery
safety_requirements: Resolve OCP1 and OCP2 separately; never query the tilde label as one sensor
Bind each reading to the installed card serial and exact sensing source
Prove same target across IB/OOB and retain complete SDR/Sensor List before filters
Record passive link/traffic/cooling state because adapter temperature is load-dependent
Do not flap links, disable ports, service cards, generate traffic, change thresholds, reset BMC or clear logs
Stop on missing/stale/invalid data, unsafe temperature, link fault, cross-path mismatch or BMC instability; no automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Verify source, slot/card topology and same-target IB/OOB identity
Collect complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List plus exact OCP1/OCP2 records
Prepare Web parity and passive card/link/thermal/SEL context
Perform no traffic, link/card/threshold control or verdict
engineer_actions: Approve slot/card identity and sensing-source semantics
Confirm Web mappings and absent-slot handling
Review both sensors with link/load context and issue the verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Incomplete: literal range, OOB-only exact query, capped SDR, credential exposure and missing Sensor List/Web evidence do not satisfy the source.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use secret-safe same-target IB/OOB sessions for complete SDR and Sensor List, query each mapped OCP sensor, bind it to the installed card serial and compare Web evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: OCP1~2, four command views, Web and 3/3-minute estimates remain; slot/card identity and limits are not guessed.

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES OCP SLOT/CARD SENSOR MAP, THERMAL CRITERIA AND CROSS-PATH PACKAGE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a two-row slot/card-serial sensor matrix and reconcile complete IB/OOB raw data with Web evidence under recorded passive link/load state.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds installed-card and sensing-source provenance plus same-target parity.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A literal OCP range or motherboard proxy without documented mapping cannot prove two adapter channels.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Adapter replacements and proxy sensors can change thermal meaning without changing the OCP label, causing a false healthy result.

project_override_considerations: Unfitted OCP slots require explicit N/A handling. Cards without a supported temperature source or designs with one shared board probe need an owner-approved coverage rule rather than duplicated values.
expected_evidence: OCP slot/BDF/interface and installed card PN/serial inventory
Per-card sensing source, SDR/entity/description and Web mapping
Complete redacted IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List outputs
Two-record cross-path value/state parity with units/freshness/limits
BMC Web entries and passive link/traffic/fan/SEL context

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The row consistently targets OCP1/OCP2 temperatures across IB/OOB and Web. Missing card mapping and limits are readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: A passive two-card thermal check is identifiable; slot/card mapping and criteria are supplyable under ED-36.

review_improvement: Adds physical OCP card and sensing-source provenance, restores complete cross-path coverage and protects live network state.
independent_technical_reasoning: OCP labels describe platform positions, not necessarily a stable sensor source. One design may expose controller junction temperature while another exposes a nearby board probe; adapter replacement also changes thermal limits. Binding slot, serial and source before cross-path comparison prevents a plausible but irrelevant proxy reading from passing the card.
